courses.title: The Portal of your Sacred Heart
courses.description: A four-week course first given live in December 2024 and now sold as recordings: four two-hour sessions of guided journeys, channelled messages and sung sound-healing transmissions, plus a daily oracle-card reading. It centres on the heart, self-love and letting go of old patterns and beliefs.

left_out: Calming your Mind – Activating your Higher Mind (https://marysol.vision/product/calming-your-mind-activating-your-higher-mind/): a live online event dated Saturday 7 November 2026, before 16 November; not a health reason (the page's mention of anxiety is allowed now).
flags: The Portal of your Sacred Heart: the Week 3 Winter Solstice session includes a clearing by guest Patrice Krysztofiak, billed as 'a Medical Medium and Energy Channeler'.
